description:
Run a multiple linear regression analysis to predict 'Exam' scores based on 'Revise' (time spent revising) and 'Anxiety' (exam anxiety). Use the 'ExamAnxiety.csv' dataset which is already loaded. 

1. Run the regression: Exam ~ Revise + Anxiety.
2. Enable 'Confidence Intervals' (95%) for the Model Coefficients.
3. Save the Jamovi analysis to '~/Documents/Jamovi/prediction_model.omv'.
4. Using the resulting coefficients, manually calculate the predicted Exam score for a student who studied for 10 hours (Revise=10) and has an Anxiety score of 50 (Anxiety=50).
5. Create a text report at '~/Documents/Jamovi/prediction_report.txt' with the exact following format (values rounded to 2 decimal places):

Intercept: [value]
Revise_B: [value]
Anxiety_B: [value]
Predicted_Score: [value]
Revise_95_CI_Lower: [value]
